metaTitle: RV GPS vs Phone Navigation Apps
description: Compare RV-specific GPS units and apps with standard phone maps on low bridges, weight limits, offline maps, cost and what to enter in your rig profile.
directAnswer: Use an RV-aware GPS or app with your rig's height, weight and length for tall or long rigs, since standard phone maps route like cars. Keep a phone map as a backup and download offline maps before you leave.
